reviewed: 46_result: temperature lowers overconfidence without altering accuracy; noise refit improves low-shot decisions,but high-shot temperature has better CE.

definition: Global2qubit depolarization rho->(1-p)rho+pI/4 applied once afterCX;independent symmetric readout bit flip probability r perqubit. Ideal basis rotations. Exact Born probabilities transformed before grouped multinomial draws.
validation: Independent Qiskit Aer density-matrix channel and basis rotations compared against fast probability transformation.
scope: Hypothetical stress test,not IBM-calibrated device model;no depth dependence,crosstalk,drift or per-gate errors;no hardware extrapolation claim.
